description: This file contains a C# class implementing an Orleans grain for testing stream immutability, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, sending objects, and managing a test object with a string property. It also defines a serializable class for the test object.

classes.name: StreamingImmutabilityTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class for testing stream immutability, managing stream subscriptions, and handling a test object.

classes.name: StreamImmutabilityTestObject
classes.description: A serializable class representing the test object with a string property used in stream communication.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified stream using a GUID and provider name.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStream
methods.description: Unsubscribes from the current stream subscription if active.

methods.name: SendTestObject
methods.description: Sends the current test object to the stream.

methods.name: SetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Sets the string property of the test object.

methods.name: GetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the string property of the test object.

methods.name: GetSiloIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the silo hosting the grain.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream messages by updating the local test object.
